change.new_diagnostics: Original census metadata plus each fresh census candidate and bounded named-job PID list; records survive incomplete snapshots.

change.bound: At most three fresh census/job passes per denied PID, two 75ms planned sleeps, shared 150ms deadline across one snapshot. OS scheduling/API delays can exceed elapsed deadline; no renewed wait after it expires. The existing OpenProcess retry adds one 25ms planned sleep on initial access denial; this patch changes only the census reconciliation budget.
change.fatal: Persistent candidate, any listed job PID, changed image/parent, unavailable verification or exhausted budget.
change.runtime_verification: Not attempted; no emulator/process launch or shutdown.
